messages: Maya: quick follow-up from today's design review — thinking about regrouping sidebar items into a single 'Serving' bucket. idea: Models + Deployments + Routes live under Serving. keeps surface area smaller and makes the breadcrumb path more consistent. thoughts? :thinking_face: Alex: :eyes: I like the consolidation. 1 technical note: deep links need stable slugs. if we move /models/:id -> /serving/models/:id we should add redirects and route aliases to avoid breaking existing permalinks. can do a 301 redirect at CDN edge or client-side history.replace. Sam: keyboard/nav a11y check — if we change the tree, make sure arrow key behavior and aria-expanded semantics don't regress. also aria-current should be set on the leaf route, not the group header. Diane: agree with Maya. also copy nit: use "Serving" vs "Runtime"? users were confused last week when we had both. prefer plain "Serving". Alex: +1 on copy. implementation detail: if we add aliases, prefer route mapping like: ``` { path: '/m/:id', redirect: '/serving/models/:id' } { path: '/d/:id', redirect: '/serving/deployments/:id' } ``` so old links keep working. small serverless worker can handle mass redirects too. Maya: nice — would we also support deep links to UI states like "open sidepanel to settings"? e.g. /serving/models/123?panel=settings — helps linking into nested modals. Joe: watch out for private deployments + SSO. some customers have URL signing and canonical hostnames. redirects need to preserve hostname and path, don't rewrite host. also document the migration in the private deploy upgrade notes. Sam: for focus management when deep-linking to a panel, ensure we call focus() on the dialog header and add role="dialog" + aria-modal if it's modal-like. fallback: announce with live-region. Diane: analytics question — if we change nav grouping, some dashboards use route-based funnels. we should add event mappings so historical dashboards don't break. pinging @eng-bot to create a tracking ticket. :memo: eng-bot: created ticket INC-4821: "Nav IA change — analytics mapping + redirect plan" and assigned to product-analytics. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4821 Alex: one more thing — trailing slash normalization. make sure both /serving/models and /serving/models/ map consistently; otherwise the breadcrumb link generator can produce double-slash. small regex fix in router utils will handle it. Maya: perfect. next steps: Alex to prototype redirect map + route aliases, Sam to run a11y checklist on the updated tree, Diane to update copy and analytics ticket, Joe to add private-deploy note. I'll consolidate in the design doc and post a diff. thanks all :thumbsup:
